{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for the 6 QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print("Number of QA orders (revenue = 999999.99):", len(qa_orders))
print("First few QA order IDs:", qa_orders['order_id'].tolist()[:3])

# Filter for completed orders only
completed = df[df['status'] == 'completed']
print("Number of completed orders:", len(completed))

# Convert revenue to float: remove commas and cast
completed['revenue_float'] = completed['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for any remaining non-numeric values
print("Any non-numeric revenue values after cleaning?", completed['revenue_float'].isna().sum() > 0)

# Check if the QA orders are included in completed
qa_in_completed = completed[completed['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print("QA orders in completed?", len(qa_in_completed))"}
